title: GTA 6: The Album Announced, Pre-Orders Available Now
text: GTA 6: The Album Announced, Pre-Orders Available Now | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA Music GTA 6: The Album Announced, Pre-Orders Available Now Several tracks revealed by Stephen Tailby 7 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has announced the official GTA 6 album, and it's now available for pre-order via Atlantic Records. Via the official site , you can pre-purchase the album on CD or vinyl, with the latter available in two options — a standard edition and a limited edition. You can also pre-save the album on music services like Apple Music, Spotify, and so on. GTA 6: The Album is a collection of 34 brand new original tracks produced for the upcoming game. Only a handful of the tracks have been revealed so far: Yung Lean - That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott - RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy - Sexy Magic Morgan Wallen - Last Thing You Need Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000 Keith Richards - Bright Lights, Big City All these songs can be streamed right now on all the usual services. Left to right: the CD, standard vinyl, and limited edition vinyl The CD version will set you back $19.98/£10.99, while the standard vinyl goes for $49.98/£44.99. The limited edition vinyl set, which includes "two transparent magenta discs filled with blue liquid" and exclusive artwork and packaging, retails for $124.98/£108.99. Whichever version you go for, the album is set to release alongside the game on 19th November. Are you planning on picking up the GTA 6 album? Tell us in the comments section below.
